parsed.explanation: The write-up derives only the weak bound "g(x) > -x" in §1 and never rules out g(t) < 0. §3's exclusion argument treats only two distinct positive values c1 > c2 > 0, yet the stated dichotomy jumps to V ⊆ {0} or V ⊆ {0,c}, silently discarding negative values; §5 then uses "b = g(z) belongs to {0,c}", which depends on that dichotomy. No other passage establishes nonnegativity. The standard one-sentence fix (if g(t) = -e < 0, then by (4) g(t - ne) = -e and the orbit t - ne becomes non-positive, contradicting f > 0 on R_{>0}) is absent, so L5.3 is not established as written; repair is a single sentence.
